name: richmond-race-lab
description: Browser-local race-route closure and staffing planning prototype for Richmond, Virginia.

scripts.test: node tests/model.test.cjs && node tests/planning.test.cjs && node tests/regression.test.cjs
scripts.lint: eslint dist/model.js dist/planning.js dist/app.js tests tools/serve.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write dist/model.js dist/planning.js dist/app.js dist/style.css dist/index.html tests tools/serve.cjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check dist/model.js dist/planning.js dist/app.js dist/style.css dist/index.html tests tools/serve.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:ui
